title: Concept: Repository with releases disabled
description: pom.xml declares a repository that serves only snapshots, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a repository that serves only snapshots.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a repository that serves only snapshots.
